label: EnGenius Neutron EWS1200-28TFP 24-port PoE+ switch
description: EnGenius Neutron EWS1200-28TFP - 24x 10/100/1000 RJ45 with 802.3af/at PoE+ (30 W per port, 410 W total budget) plus 4x SFP uplinks, 19-inch 1U, web-managed with on-board Neutron tools and ezMaster. Layer 2 switching with 802.1Q VLAN, 802.1X and ACLs.
notes: The key-feature list says `4 x SFP Ports` and the prose on the same page advertises `1-10 Gbps SFP+ slot options` - boilerplate shared with the 48-port model. The named part wins: SFP, 1G, and no 10G capability is claimed here, because accepting a 10G module in a 1G cage would be a link the hardware cannot make. The request filed this as a Layer 3 switch; the page calls it `Full-Featured Layer 2 Switching`, so it is modelled as an L2 switch that does not route. 802.3at/af is Type 2, 30 W per port, with the 410 W total stated on the page.
